simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בֵּית בָּרָה (H1012) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בֵּית בָּרָה (Bêyth Bârâh) means Beth-Barah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Judg 7 24.

definitions.full: H1012. Beth Barah בָּרָה בֵּית proper name, of a location in combin . וְאֶתהַֿיַּרְדֵּן בּ ׳עַד ׳בּ Judg 7:24 (twice in verse) (? = עֲבָרָה בֵּית place of ford ).
definitions.rootNote: probably from 1004 and 5679 ; house of (the) ford;
